title: Sarla Devi Yadav v. Kanpur Electrical Supply Company Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pankaj Mithal, J. and Saral Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; relegated to Executive Engineer under Clause 6.14.
headnote: A consumer facing a recovery certificate for electricity dues who seeks installment repayment may be left to represent to the Executive Engineer, who is to fix installments in accordance with Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within two weeks of that representation. The writ is disposed of on that direction without a merits decision on the recovery.
facts: Sarla Devi Yadav challenged a recovery certificate dated 23 February 2019 for Rs. 1,19,485 as electricity dues of Kanpur Electrical Supply Company Ltd. She told the High Court that she had already cleared the dues but the cheque had bounced, and that she was ready to pay the amount again if installments were fixed. Counsel for the supply company was heard. The Division Bench disposed of the writ on that representation without examining the recovery certificate on merits.

holding_units.holding: Where the consumer, facing a recovery certificate for electricity dues, seeks installment repayment after a bounced cheque, the writ court may dispose of the petition by permitting a representation to the Executive Engineer, who shall fix installments in accordance with Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within two weeks of the representation. The recovery is not examined on merits.

principle_tags.application: Installment of electricity dues under recovery was not granted by the writ court; the consumer was sent to the Executive Engineer to fix installments under Clause 6.14 within two weeks of representation.

not_decided.point: validity of the recovery certificate dated 23.02.2019
whether the petitioner had already cleared the dues and whether the cheque had bounced
